historical_probes.long: L1 SMA200: first observed session each month, next-session open to open 20 sessions later
historical_probes.intraday: I2 opening-hour return below -0.5%: 11:10 open to 13:10 open, all six completed 10-minute opening bars required
historical_probes.meaning: Signal markouts only, not portfolio P&L or production-strategy replication. Price-only, no dividends, no shorts, current-universe selection bias. No historical order-book eligibility inferred.

weekly_policy: Report unchanged baseline and all three cohorts; missing sessions cannot count as passed. No automatic parameter changes or promotion to trading.
